title: Facebook Ads For Beauty Salon : Best Practices & Ideas In 2026

facts.fact: The article presents 7 Facebook ads best practices and ideas for beauty salons.
facts.quote: Here are 7 best options that you can choose for your beauty salon.

facts.fact: The page's date line shows the article was dated March 26, 2024 and carries a later date of February 6, 2026.
The article states that Facebook lets advertisers target by age, behavior, and interests.
facts.quote: You can not only choose the particular age that you want to target but, behavior and interests too.

facts.fact: The article lists campaign goals that Facebook ads can serve for a beauty salon, including generating new customer leads, bringing new bookings, increasing brand awareness, and driving website traffic.
facts.quote: Your goal of running a campaign can help generate new customer leads and bring new bookings, increase awareness of your brand, promote particular products or services, drive traffic to your website, and more.
